dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe one purpose: auditing a domain's citation trust and authority against a declared peer cohort using the CITE framework.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to collecting domain, backlink, identity, trust, search, and peer-cohort evidence, with fail-closed behavior when required scoring/runtime files are unavailable.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill and reference files only; duplicated files are byte-identical and no executable install hooks or background workers are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may use user-provided analytics, search console, backlink, or security evidence, which is proportionate for domain-authority auditing but can include sensitive business data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to an explicitly authorized audit artifact path, and standalone mode is instructed not to write artifacts, mutate registries, fetch mutable sources, or compute substitute scores.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, expect this skill to analyze public and user-supplied SEO/domain evidence and optionally save a validated audit report only when you authorize it. Provide only the console, analytics, backlink, or security exports you are comfortable using for the audit.
llm.summary: This skill is a coherent domain-authority auditing guide with disclosed evidence collection, local scoring, and optional report saving only after authorization.
